claims.text: The 2010 Brazilian military inquiry concluded that 'this citizen, probably being dirty, due to the heavy rains and seen crouching by a wall, was mistaken by the three terrified girls as a space creature', and that the movements of Fire Brigade, Army and EsSA vehicles 'were real facts ... incorrectly interpreted'.
